about: Hand-kept judgement that no document records, joined by scripts/inventory/inventory.mjs with what it reads from the repository. A feature id is the generator's (section number and a slug of the checklist row); an id that matches no feature is reported in INVENTORY.md. Every statement names where it comes from: the feature checklist, the ledger (CHECKPOINTS.md), a doc, a commit, or the round R4 brief of 2026-10-11 (the operator's hands-on preview of a300851 and the usability gaps a guide listed). Ranges are estimates, never measurements.

The lead's merge of the round's branches, the full suite, then one scripted Mac run (r24) of the merged head.
stages.range: about one helper round and one Mac run: roughly 2 to 5 hours of wall time

stages.title: A connected beta (outside testers on their own computers)

remaining: npm publish: HOLD until the operator lifts it.

assumptions: The sandboxes and the Windows computers are available, and their cost stays within a recorded cap.
